question: Should the dashboard widget authoring SDK and starter gallery be accepted as part of the bundled dashboard plugin/docs stack, or should it wait, be narrowed, or move to a plugin/ClawHub-owned path?
rationale: The requested surface documents security-adjacent custom widgets and new builtin renderer conventions that are absent from current main and already proposed in an open contributor PR, so automation should not create a parallel implementation or close the issue before maintainer direction.

options.title: Review linked PR path
options.body: Keep this issue open and use the open dashboard SDK PR as the implementation candidate after the base dashboard stack is accepted.

options.title: Narrow to docs-only
options.body: Ask for the authoring guide and examples to be split from chart/runtime work if maintainers want a smaller review unit.

options.title: Move outside core
options.body: Redirect the starter gallery to ClawHub or external plugin docs if maintainers decide bundled dashboard widget authoring should not be a core docs surface.

recommendation.title: Review linked PR path
recommendation.body: Keep this issue open and use the open dashboard SDK PR as the implementation candidate after the base dashboard stack is accepted.

likelyOwner.reason: The strongest merged-history signal is the current Control UI plugin-tab seam, introduced through the merged Logbook PR that the dashboard proposal reuses.
